text:
samira: Thanks for coming to the security segment. Dropping a compact follow-up thread for items we promised to answer (audit bundles, KMS history, VPC exports).
ben: Quick one: auditors asked whether evidence bundles are reproducible and how to prove integrity after export. What do we ship?
oliver: Plan is a signed manifest per export + an immutable object flag on the customer bucket. Manifest will include bundle_id, requester, ticket_ref, purpose, timestamp, and sha256. The service signs the manifest with the platform signing key.
tess: Can we also include a human-readable chain-of-custody log (who downloaded, who approved)? Auditors want that.
oliver: Yes — download events will be emitted to the audit index and an entry will be appended to the bundle provenance file. We'll surface a compact provenance view in the console.
ben: BYOK/HSM question: can customers see rotation history and attestations?
os: (typo) oliver: For cloud-managed keys we return rotation timestamps and principal ids through the control-plane API. For HSM/BYOK we will include the vendor attestation blob with each rotation and a normalized rotation_event entry in the bundle. Formatting TBD.
sec-bot: Deployment: evidence-exporter v2.0 rolled out by oliver at 2301239950.
tess: VPC flow logs: customers asked for an example to stream logs into their SIEM with least privilege. Can we provide a recipe?
oliver: Yes — we'll publish an infra recipe with an IAM role example and a sample CLI. Example CLI snippet: ```redwood infra export-flow --vpc vpc-0abc --dest s3://cust-logs/ --role arn:aws:iam::999888777:role/RedwoodFlowExport```
ben: Who owns the public wording about retention tiers (auditors want concrete numbers)?
samira: I'll draft the retention table. Proposed defaults: 1 year hot, 3 years warm, 7 years archive (enterprise add-on up to 10y). Legal will review before we publish.
tess: Small UX ask: console should show a "bundle provenance" card with requested_by, signed_by, replication_status, and download history.
oliver: I'll add a small ticket to infra backlog for the UI card.
ben: Please list owners and due dates so we can close this loop.
samira: Owners: - Draft public retention FAQ (owner: samira, due: 2026-05-05) - Implement signed manifest + sha256 (owner: oliver, due: 2026-05-12) - Add provenance events to audit index + console card (owner: oliver, due: 2026-05-20) - Flow log export recipe + IAM samples (owner: tess, due: 2026-04-30) - HSM attestation format + pilot plan (owner: ben, due: 2026-06-15)
ben: Perfect. I'll coordinate legal review for the FAQ once draft is ready.
tess: I'll post the IAM templates to #eng-security and link back here.
sec-bot: Reminder: create Jira ticket 'evidence-provenance-ui' and tag `soc2`.
samira: Thanks all 94 I'll post a Confluence stub and tag reviewers when ready.
ben: :thumbsup:
